import java.util.*;

class Edge {
    int src, dst;
    int cap;
    long cost;
    Edge rev;
    Edge(int s, int d, int c, long co, Edge r) {
        src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = r;
    }
}

class FlowBase {
    ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> adj;
    FlowBase(int n) {
        adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
    }
    int size() { return adj.size(); }
    ArrayList<Edge> get(int node) { return adj.get(node); }
    void addEdgeBase(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
        if (cap <= 0) return;
        Edge fwd = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
        Edge rev = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost, null);
        fwd.rev = rev;
        rev.rev = fwd;
        adj.get(src).add(fwd);
        adj.get(dst).add(rev);
    }
}

class MinCostFlow extends FlowBase {
    long minCost, totalCost;
    int[] supp;
    long[] ptnl;
    MinCostFlow(int n) {
        super(n);
        minCost = 0;
        totalCost = 0;
        supp = new int[n];
        ptnl = new long[n];
    }
    void addEdge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
        if (cap <= 0) return;
        if (cost < 0) {
            supp[src] -= cap;
            supp[dst] += cap;
            minCost += cap * cost;
            totalCost -= cap * cost;
            addEdgeBase(dst, src, cap, -cost);
        } else {
            totalCost += cap * cost;
            addEdgeBase(src, dst, cap, cost);
        }
    }
    void supply(int node, int vol) { supp[node] += vol; }
    boolean SPFA(Edge[] last) {
        long infty = totalCost + 1;
        long[] dist = new long[size()];
        boolean[] inq = new boolean[size()];
        Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int node = 0; node < size(); node++) {
            if (supp[node] > 0) {
                dist[node] = 0;
                q.add(node);
                inq[node] = true;
            }
        }
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int node = q.poll();
            inq[node] = false;
            for (Edge e : get(node)) {
                if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                if (dist[e.dst] > dist[node] + e.cost + ptnl[node] - ptnl[e.dst]) {
                    dist[e.dst] = dist[node] + e.cost + ptnl[node] - ptnl[e.dst];
                    last[e.dst] = e;
                    if (!inq[e.dst]) {
                        q.add(e.dst);
                        inq[e.dst] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int node = 0; node < size(); node++) {
            if (dist[node] < infty) ptnl[node] += dist[node];
        }
        return true;
    }
    boolean flow() {
        boolean aug = true;
        while (aug) {
            aug = false;
            Edge[] last = new Edge[size()];
            SPFA(last);
            boolean[] shut = new boolean[size()];
            for (int dst = 0; dst < size(); dst++) {
                if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                    int resid = -supp[dst];
                    int src = dst;
                    int block = -1;
                    while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                        if (resid >= last[src].cap) {
                            block = src;
                            resid = last[src].cap;
                        }
                        src = last[src].src;
                    }
                    if (shut[src]) {
                        block = src;
                    } else {
                        if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                            resid = supp[src];
                            block = src;
                        }
                        for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                            last[node].cap -= resid;
                            last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                        }
                        supp[src] -= resid;
                        supp[dst] += resid;
                        minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                        aug = true;
                    }
                    if (block != -1) {
                        for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) shut[node] = true;
                        shut[block] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int s : supp) if (s > 0) return false;
        return true;
    }
    long optimal() {
        return flow() ? minCost : -1;
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
